lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima arranged in quasi-linear rows following the longitudinal axis, posterior to the shadowed gill region, with higher density in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical diffuse high-luminance bands intersecting with discrete white centroids, forming a grid-like structure of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp light-to-dark vertical pixel intensity gradient, defining parallel longitudinal ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated low-luminance silhouettes (commensal Echeneidae) swimming in the ventral water column beneath the pectoral fin.
